entities.summary: Kuzma Pavlovich Chaynikov, better known as Kuzebay Gerd was an Udmurt language poet, a prose writer, a playwright, a public figure, and a nationalist. He was executed in Sandarmokh during the Great Purge and was posthumously rehabilitated (exonerated) in 1958.
